Heard the counsel for the revisionist and State.

2. Present revision has been filed against the order dated 23.06.2023 passed by learned S.D.J.M.,
Dhanbad, in Complaint Case No. 296/2023 whereby complaint filed by the complainant/revisionist has been dismissed.
3. It appears that complainant has got married with one of the accused namely Rakhi Devi.
There was matrimonial dispute and there was litigation between the parties.
The wife has lodged a petition under Section 498A IPC in which police has submitted final form.
The husband has filed a case for divorce.

Three years after, the present complaint case has been filed, making allegation that he has Manoj Kumar Pramanik vs State Of Jharkhand on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/12490347/

sentences.text: 4. From perusal of the record, it appears that the court below has evaluated the evidence and has recorded the finding and disbelieved some of the allegations.
It is settled principle of law that the court below is in better position to assess the statement of the witnesses.
After assessing the witnesses, the finding has been recorded.
5. It is not the case of the revisionist that the material evidence has not been considered or further any extraneous consideration is there, rather it is a case of evaluation of the evidence.
It is purely in the domain of the court below and he is always in a better position.
This court finds that the court below has rightly taken into consideration the material brought before him.
6. In view of the above discussions, I find no reason to entertain this revision.
Accordingly, it is hereby, dismissed.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Ravi/-
